payload.explanation: pg_stat_activity shows the business request session_6f0bc72e72cb active on 'UPDATE inventory SET stock=stock-1 WHERE product_id=1' waiting on Lock:transactionid, blocked by session_dbbd99260e63 (pid 949), which is 'idle in transaction' after having executed the same UPDATE (it holds the row/transaction lock and is waiting on ClientRead, i.e., an uncommitted abandoned transaction). Two other idle-in-transaction sessions (session_b01560a92efa, session_f5f2d94ae661) hold no blocking role. Query stats confirm only one UPDATE has completed (rows=1), consistent with the blocker's uncommitted decrement. Indexes show only the primary key, so no redundant index or large-data/vacuum issue is indicated. Root cause: lock contention from an idle-in-transaction session holding the lock; remediation is rollback of session_dbbd99260e63, which is eligible as a project-owned session and preserves the business request. Uncertainty: none material; blocking chain is directly observed via pg_blocking_pids.
